claims.summary: For d>=5 in characteristic different from two, the three sequential disjoint-pair limit of the dimension-seven collision series is, up to a mark-unit, the eight-character elliptic space Y_d=sum_S w_S*g_S*F_(8d-17) with the displayed degree-four g_S. Its dimension is N=64d-128; inside L(MH), M=16d-23 and H the four infinity points, it is cut out by four top coefficients and 32 independent Hasse remainder conditions. Normality is equivalent to invertibility of the resulting 36-square map on L(MH-NP), or a 32-square map when (M-9)H-NP is nonprincipal. One admissible nonzero specialization transfers to the original V_(7,d). Uniform nonvanishing and degrees 2-4 are not asserted.
claims.assessment: Working reduction passed by one isolated medium reviewer after scope and presentation corrections. Uniform determinant nonvanishing remains open. The degree-seven finite-cut lemma gives the third safe merge; exact normalization, Riemann-Roch and top-coordinate elimination give the criterion. Independent degree-five controls in characteristics 3,5,7 agree on direct and table spans and the 36/32 kernel maps.
claims.rationale: Gives the first exact higher-dimensional coupled determinant after completion of dimension-six normality. This is a necessary-route reduction, not a solution of the stable-order conjecture or any pre-stable threshold.
claims.next_action: Evaluate a generic coefficient of the actual 32-condition map or its fully saturated rational boundary, retaining exceptional character profiles and treating degrees 2-4 separately.
